proposedUI.content: Automatic turnaround or Fixed dates as the Studio default. Configurable timing presets; project exceptions available.
Name the stage and WIP, for example Edit - WIP1. Distinguish Internal review and Client delivery. Show actual due dates and remaining working days. Preserve a separate final-delivery date.

The compact Videos deadline column shows a named active Waiting on Studio stage deadline and a separate final-delivery date. Stages Waiting on Client or complete do not show an active Studio turnaround countdown. For multiple active stages, earliest +N stages disclosure is a proposal to review; all active stage deadlines remain available in details.

proposedBehaviour: Start an applicable turnaround cycle on the real Waiting on Studio transition, not on render or reassignment.
Close the current delivery cycle when the WIP is released to the Client; Client waiting time does not consume the Studio's next turnaround allowance.
Start the next revision cycle on the relevant feedback handoff back to Waiting on Studio.
Keep internal WIP delivery distinct from Client release and stage approval.
Reassigning a person does not reset the stage timer.
Separate estimated effort hours used for Freelancer pricing from working-day turnaround.
Clients see their delivery promise; internal review targets remain Studio/assigned-Filmmaker information under existing visibility rules.
preservation: No automatic migration, clearing or shifting of existing manually promised dates.
Studio default changes should apply to future cycles; changes to an active cycle require an explicit project-level action.
Final delivery remains a separate fixed commitment.
Use the current adaptable production flow; do not apply a three-day Edit preset indiscriminately to shoots, pinned Media or complex animation.
Application code, stored records, assets and dependencies stay unchanged during this proposal step.
beforeImplementation: Agree the visual proposal and mode/override behaviour.
Resolve the internal WIP anchor relative to the stage clock and any late assignment.
Agree an internal review target for revision rounds if one is needed.
Agree fractional-minute rounding and relevant animation exceptions.
Define how legacy stages without a recorded entry timestamp appear, preserving existing dates and avoiding invented start times.
Define the prototype's demo-time reference without changing records merely to make deadlines look current.
